dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: （恐れ入ります。本日18時～19時でロールプレイ相談者役で申込成立し、只今待機中です）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry to bother you. My application for the role-playing client session from 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM today was confirmed, and I am currently waiting.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。大変お待たせいたしました。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm very sorry to have kept you waiting.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。それでは、お時間少なくなってしまいましたが、さっそく始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: I apologize. Our time is a bit short, but let's get started right away.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 本日は、どのようなご相談でいらっしゃいましたか？ご相談に先立ち、ご年齢と性別、ご相談の内容を簡単におはなしいただけるとありがたいです。
dialogue.English: What brings you here for a consultation today? Before we begin, it would be helpful if you could briefly share your age, gender, and the nature of your concern.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 年齢は40代、女です。年老いた両親のことで色々と考えています
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 40s. I've been thinking a lot about my elderly parents.

dialogue.content: 両親とは別居です。
dialogue.English: I live separately from my parents.

dialogue.content: お年を召されたご両親のお話ですね。
dialogue.English: So, this is about your elderly parents.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いかがされましたか？
dialogue.English: What seems to be the matter?

dialogue.content: 父が体調を崩し、先日退院し今は実家で母と一緒にいるのですが
dialogue.English: My father fell ill and was recently discharged from the hospital. He's at home with my mother now, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 母の体調も心配で
dialogue.English: I'm also worried about my mother's health.

dialogue.content: お母様も…
dialogue.English: Your mother as well...

dialogue.content: 遠くに住んでいるもので簡単には会いに行けず
dialogue.English: I live far away, so I can't visit them easily.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 母は疲れやすいので
dialogue.English: My mother gets tired easily.

dialogue.content: それは、心配ですね
dialogue.English: That must be worrying.

dialogue.content: はい。母は何か病気になっているわけではないです
dialogue.English: Yes. It's not that my mother has any particular illness.

dialogue.content: 病気ではない…ちなみに、おいくつでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: Not an illness... By the way, how old are they?

dialogue.content: 両親ともに70代後半です
dialogue.English: Both of my parents are in their late 70s.

dialogue.content: 兄夫婦が近くに住んでいますので、色々な意味で安心していたのですが
dialogue.English: My brother and his wife live nearby, so in many ways I had felt reassured, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 兄夫婦は共働きで忙しいらしく
dialogue.English: My brother and his wife both work and seem to be busy, and...

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 両親も気をつかって、兄夫婦には迷惑かけないようにしているのです
dialogue.English: My parents are also considerate and try not to be a burden to my brother and his wife.

dialogue.content: 私は離れているので何もできず
dialogue.English: Since I live far away, I can't really do anything.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: ご心配募るお気持ち、お察しいたします
dialogue.English: I can imagine how your worries must be growing.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます｡私は実家から出ているので兄夫婦の立場も考えないといけないなとも思っています
dialogue.English: Thank you. Since I've moved away from home, I feel I also have to consider my brother and his wife's position.

dialogue.content: 複雑です
dialogue.English: It's complicated.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。気丈なご両親とはいえご自身たちだけでできることにも限りが生じるお年頃ですね。お兄様のお立場も配慮されると確かにちゃちゃを入れているようなことになるのははばかられますね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Even though your parents are strong-willed, they are at an age where there are limits to what they can do on their own. And considering your brother's position, I can see why you'd hesitate to get involved, as it might seem like you're meddling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そういう感じです
dialogue.English: That's exactly how it feels.

dialogue.content: 現状、退院されたお父様の身の回りのお世話は、お母様がおひとりで頑張っていらっしゃるということでしょうか
dialogue.English: As things stand, is your mother taking care of your father's daily needs all by herself?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 母は大丈夫だよと
dialogue.English: My mother says she's fine.

dialogue.content: 心配かけたくないようです
dialogue.English: She seems not to want to worry us.

dialogue.content: なんとも、心苦しい状態ですね。
dialogue.English: That's a truly distressing situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お兄様のご家族は、そのご様子について、どのようにお考えなのでしょうか？お話しされたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: What does your brother's family think about this situation? Have you talked with them about it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もしよろしければ、少しお話しいただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you tell me a little about that?

dialogue.content: 両親がそれで良いって言ってるのだから、余計な心配いらないんじゃないという感じです
dialogue.English: They seem to think that since our parents say it's fine, there's no need for unnecessary worry.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうはいっても、ご心配なのですよね
dialogue.English: Even so, you're still concerned, aren't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 明らかに両親は大変だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's clear my parents are having a hard time.

dialogue.content: 兄夫婦も忙しいのはわかりますが
dialogue.English: I understand that my brother and his wife are busy, but...

dialogue.content: これで良いのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if this is really okay.

dialogue.content: と色々考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: I just keep thinking about it.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ご心配なお気持ちは、状況からもお察しいたします。どのようなことで、ご両親のお力になりたいか、なにかお考えはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Given the situation, your concern is very understandable. In what ways would you like to support your parents? Do you have any ideas?

dialogue.content: 本当はそばにいたい気持ちですが
dialogue.English: I really want to be there with them, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは現実的に厳しくて
dialogue.English: That's not realistically possible.

dialogue.content: はい、たしかに。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: 私の家庭や仕事がありますので
dialogue.English: I have my own family and job.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: それでも
dialogue.English: Even so,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 近くで看てくれる人がいれば
dialogue.English: If there was someone nearby who could look after them...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 少しは安心できそうです
dialogue.English: I think I could feel a bit more at ease.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分は何もできないのですが
dialogue.English: I can't really do anything myself, but...

dialogue.content: 心配ばかりが募ります
dialogue.English: My worries just keep growing.

dialogue.content: せめて、ご両親の暮らしぶりを親身に看ることのできる方法があれば、
dialogue.English: At the very least, if there were a way for someone to check in on your parents' daily life with care,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 状況が見えない不安は除くことができそうですね
dialogue.English: it seems that could help alleviate the anxiety of not knowing their situation.

dialogue.content: ご提案なのですが
dialogue.English: I have a suggestion.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Please, go ahead.

dialogue.content: 地域包括支援センターというものが、全国各自治体にあります。
dialogue.English: There are Regional Comprehensive Support Centers in every municipality across the country.

dialogue.content: ご存じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you familiar with them?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: はじめて聴きます
dialogue.English: This is the first I've heard of them.

dialogue.content: ここは、厚労省の地域包括ケアシステムの施策で、高齢者および、その家族を対象に
dialogue.English: They are part of the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's regional comprehensive care system policy, and they are for older adults and their families.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 高齢者が要介護になっても住み慣れた地域で過ごせるように、「住まい」「介護」「医療」「予防」「生活支援」といった必要なサービスを、地域一帯となって提供する体制を目指しています。
dialogue.English: They aim to build a system in which the community as a whole provides necessary services—housing, long-term care, medical care, prevention, and daily living support—so that even if older adults require care, they can continue living in their familiar community.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 社会福祉士や看護師といった専門の方が無料で相談に応じてくれます。
dialogue.English: Specialists such as certified social workers and nurses offer free consultations.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: Oh, is that so?

dialogue.content: 見守りを依頼することもできます。
dialogue.English: You can also ask them to check in on your parents.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: 貴重な情報
dialogue.English: That's valuable information.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 早速調べてみます
dialogue.English: I'll look into it right away.

dialogue.content: お兄様のご家族とご相談されて、センターに見守りをお願いしてみるもの、一つの手段かと思いました。
dialogue.English: After discussing it with your brother's family, asking the Center to provide check-ins might be one option.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right.

dialogue.content: ぜひ。中学校区を目安に設置しているようですよ。
dialogue.English: Please do. They are typically established for each junior high school district.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 専門家の見立てで、処置等が必要であれば、お知らせいただけます！
dialogue.English: Based on the professionals' assessment, they will let you know if any measures or services are needed!

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 本日は、大切なお話のある中、長いお時間お待たせいたしてしまい、申し訳ございませんでした。
dialogue.English: I'm very sorry to have kept you waiting so long today, especially when you had such important matters to discuss.

dialogue.content: 短い時間の中で
dialogue.English: In this short amount of time,

dialogue.content: この先が見えました
dialogue.English: I can see a way forward.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていただき
dialogue.English: Thank you for thinking this through with me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。ご両親様が、お健やかに、日々を穏やかにお過ごしになられることをお祈り申し上げます。
dialogue.English: No, thank you. I pray that your parents will be able to live their days peacefully and in good health.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、本日のご相談は、これでいったん終了とさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Then, we will conclude today's session for now.

dialogue.content: また、何かありましたら、気軽にお越しくださいね。
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それでは、終了のメッセージを送らせていただきます。
dialogue.English: I will now send the closing message.

dialogue.content: はい失礼します
dialogue.English: Okay, goodbye.
